checks.name: Production shared renderer and equation timing
checks.result: Imported /shared/render-reading-text.js in the production page; it preserved superscript markup and the nsb-fraction wrapper. At speed 35, /shared/reading-word-delay.js returned 225.5 ms for a four-letter prose token and 472.5 ms for an equals sign, or 2.10x.

checks.name: Tossup fraction rendering and answer check
checks.question: 2012 NSB Sample Set 2, Packet 6, Question 6 (Math)
checks.result: The initial reader setting showed 35. The stem's x-squared fraction rendered with a stacked numerator and denominator, and its full read-as cue was visible. Entering 6 produced 1 correct, 1 tossup seen, and 4 points.

checks.name: Equation reading delay
checks.result: At reading speed 35, shared/reading-word-delay.js returned 225.5 ms for a four-letter prose token and 472.5 ms for an equation equals sign, a 2.10x delay. The browser showed the default speed as 35 before the full-read capture was accelerated for the longer prompts.

checks.name: Bonus nested fraction and answer display
checks.question: 2014 NSB Sample Set 8, Packet 2, Question 11 (Math)
checks.result: The stem rendered its powered numerator and denominator as a stacked fraction, with the read-as cue intact. Submitting 0 showed the wrong-answer state and displayed the source answer as a stacked negative fraction.

checks.name: Chemical charge and subscript rendering
checks.question: 2009 NSB Sample Set 1, Packet 5, Question 1 (Chemistry)
checks.result: The chromate ion rendered as CrO₄²⁻, with both the subscript and superscript charge visible.

checks.name: In-person history does not change scores
checks.result: In a disposable local room, a player was judged correct and Team A reached 4 while Team B remained 0. Navigating to the prior question displayed the history notice and left scores at 4–0; returning to the current question also left them at 4–0. The test room was ended after the check.
